## HubSpot Probability-Weighted Forecast Bot
**dhRobin Systems · MIT · provided as-is (see DISCLAIMER.md)**

Safe defaults: `DRY_RUN=true`, `SANDBOX_MODE=true`.
Slack posts happen only when **both** are `false`.

⚠️ **HubSpot Deal Aggregator has pinned fictional data.**
Manual runs use the pin and skip the node. **Unpin it** before you test against a live HubSpot account.
Scheduled (active) runs ignore pinned data.

Schedule: Mondays 08:00 in the workflow timezone (Settings → Timezone).
No credentials or real data are stored in this file.
